_comment: Hand-curated extra names for HoI4 locations, merged into provinces.json by tools/parse_hoi4_reference.py. Keys MUST be canonical display names already in provinces.json (the parser warns about any that aren't); values are alternative spellings a Discord poster might write in [Location:...]. Mirrors country_aliases.json, which does the same for tags.json. NOTE the direction: HoI4 is set in 1936, so the PERIOD name is usually canonical (Danzig, Stalingrad, Bombay) and the modern name is the alias — not the other way round. Keys with a leading underscore are ignored as comments.
